title: Under the launcher's isolated git environment, `git diff --cached` renders whole-file rewrites, so a freeze exported that way cannot be applied as a patch
outcome: A freeze exported with the launcher's own recipe (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs isolatedGitEnvironment: GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=NUL, and so on) applies cleanly onto another base, with minimal hunks. Or the integration procedure documents an export recipe that does, with a check that it names the same blobs as the fingerprinted index.
acceptance: Under the launcher's isolated git environment, `git diff --cached` renders whole-file rewrites, so a freeze exported that way cannot be applied as a patch is done
